verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Boomerang Throw poke while Gnar's Hop is up; you win if you land E (Apprehend) the moment his Hop (E) is down and chain into R before he caps Rage.

brief.thesis: Gnar's Boomerang Throw (Q, range 1100) outranges everything in Darius's kit, so the neutral trade belongs to him as long as Hop (E) is available to punish a bad approach. Darius's entire game plan is forcing fights during Gnar's Hop cooldown windows, where Q (Decimate), W (Crippling Strike), and E (Apprehend) can out-trade mini Gnar before his Rage bar maxes into a Mega Gnar transformation.

theirWindow.what: He will poke with Boomerang Throw from max range and threaten to bounce off a minion or you if you close in. Do not commit E (Apprehend) or walk forward here — you'll eat a slow and he escapes for free.

yourWindow.what: This is the OP.GG-confirmed engage window. Close the gap, land E (Apprehend) to pull him onto you, then Q (Decimate) and W (Crippling Strike) before he can reset distance.

start.why: 48.4% win rate over 1618 games and the 63.5% pick rate here reflects the matchup correctly — it absorbs poke damage from Boomerang Throw and hyper-charged autos so you aren't shoved off the lane before you can engage.

boots.why: 48.6% win rate, 74.5% pick — flat damage reduction on Gnar's autos (which get stronger via Hyper) and his Boomerang Throw hits matter more here than the move speed from Swiftness.

core.why: The active haste closes the distance gap on a kiting ranged champion during your Apprehend windows, and the lethality accelerates your all-in burst.
Builds move speed passively to help you reach Gnar before Hop comes back up, and the HP keeps you alive through his poke phase.
Best measured path at 52.9% win rate over 310 games — the bleedout-and-heal pattern covers you through the damage you eat closing distance each engage.

runes.keystoneWhy: The measured 48.9% win rate at 35.7% pick is the top page here — the burst of move speed after you commit to combat is exactly what you need to actually catch a kiting Gnar during his Hop cooldown, and to disengage before Mega Gnar's stun connects.

summoners.why: This page measures 50.4% win rate over the sample, the highest of the three listed combos. Ignite punishes the solo-kill windows this matchup already favors you in, securing kills before Gnar can Hop or Flash out of your Guillotine range.

playing.title: Hold trades for Hop cooldown
playing.detail: Never commit E (Apprehend) while Gnar's Hop is up — he escapes for free and you've burned your only gap-closer. Wait the 22-12s window out.

playing.title: Track the Rage bar, not just HP
playing.detail: Gnar's passive Rage fills from combat. If it's near max mid-fight, expect a Mega Gnar transformation that adds a W (Wallop) stun — disengage before he caps it rather than after.

playing.title: Don't approach in Boomerang's lane
playing.detail: Boomerang Throw has 1100 range and slows on hit. Use minion waves to screen your walk-up instead of approaching in a straight line.

playing.title: All-in the instant level 6 hits
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine (R) deals true damage that scales with Hemorrhage stacks and resets on a kill. Stack Q (Decimate) and W (Crippling Strike) bleed stacks first, then R to execute before he can Hop away.

playing.title: Respect the Mega stun, every time
playing.detail: Once Gnar transforms, W becomes an area stun instead of a speed buff. If you see the transformation trigger mid-trade, back off immediately rather than finishing the combo.

playing.title: Ignite locks kills Hop can't dodge
playing.detail: Pair Ignite's execute with your R (Noxian Guillotine) burst so a successful Hop or Flash out of range doesn't deny the kill.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch, not estimates. The mechanical reasoning — when to engage, what the Rage bar means, and why the trade windows fall where they do — is my own tactical read layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being kited by Gnar by managing your distance well. Close in on him when (E) is on cooldown to fight him.
